newsitem.title: UK: Gloom over Anagen after share suspension.
newsitem.headline: Gloom over Anagen after share suspension.

text.p: Analysts are increasingly gloomy over prospects for small UK diagnostics group Anagen Plc after its shares were suspended on the London Stock Exchange earlier on Tuesday.
The Aldershot-based company requested the suspension after talks with two potential marketing partners for its AuraFlex diagnostic system collapsed.
"With no marketing partner the company is probably dead in the water," said one analyst who asked not to be identified.
Anagen said in a statement it is "urgently reviewing the options for the AuraFlex project and the group as a whole."
The company has suffered a number of serious setbacks with its lead project, including critical press comment and the decision of Organon Teknika to pull out of a partnership arrangement.
Analysts said the company's products face severe competition in a market dominated by major players including Abott Laboratories and Boehringer Mannheim. -- London Newsroom +44 171 542 7717
